en.summary: The patch fixes a one-cycle mismatch between dirty tag and set index when generating flush and invalidate addresses in the DCache.
why_it_counts: DCache.scala removes an extra RegNext from dirtySetIdx_st0 when building InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr.
The commit subject explicitly says the flush address cycle was mismatched.
The changed expression directly forms the memory request address for flush and invalidate traffic.
evidence: dirtyTag_st1 stays aligned with a single delayed dirtySetIdx_st0 instead of a doubly delayed one.
The patch changes only the address concatenation used by InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: InvOrFluMemReq flush and invalidate address generation
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Reintroduce the extra RegNext around TagAccess.io.dirtySetIdx_st0 when constructing InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Flush or invalidate traffic carries an address built from mismatched tag/set cycles and targets the wrong line.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Flush and invalidate requests are reconstructed from pipelined tag and set information. If one field is delayed an extra cycle relative to the other, the outgoing address splices together a tag from one line and a set index from another.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush or invalidate request is generated from pipelined dirty-tag metadata.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Insert one extra register stage on the set-index path, or otherwise misalign the tag and set fields used for the maintenance address.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: extra pipeline delay on one address component
portability_notes: Delaying the tag instead of the set is an equivalent mutation if that is easier in another DUT.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that concatenates tag and set index for a flush/evict/invalidate address.
Add one extra register to exactly one of those components.
Trigger dirty-line flush traffic and observe requests targeting the wrong line.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes an extra RegNext from dirtySetIdx_st0 when building InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: At the InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr assignment, wrap TagAccess.io.dirtySetIdx_st0.get in an extra RegNext before concatenation.

evidence_for_injection: The only behavioral change is the timing of the set-index field in the address concatenation.
The commit subject explicitly says the flush address cycles were mismatched.

zh.summary: 该补丁修复了 DCache 在生成 flush 和 invalidate 地址时 dirty tag 与 set index 相差一个周期的问题。
why_it_counts: DCache.scala 在构造 InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr 时去掉了 dirtySetIdx_st0 上多余的一层 RegNext。
提交标题明确指出 flush 地址的周期不匹配。
被修改表达式直接生成 flush 和 invalidate 流量的内存请求地址。
evidence: ventus/src/L1Cache/DCache/DCache.scala 中是单文件两行改动。
dirtyTag_st1 现在与只延迟一拍的 dirtySetIdx_st0 对齐，而不是与两拍延迟值对齐。
补丁只修改了 InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr 使用的地址拼接逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: InvOrFluMemReq 的 flush 和 invalidate 地址生成逻辑
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 在构造 InvOrFluMemReq.a_addr 时，重新给 TagAccess.io.dirtySetIdx_st0 增加那一层额外的 RegNext。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: flush 或 invalidate 流量会带着由不同周期 tag/set 拼出的地址，目标 line 错误。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: flush 和 invalidate 请求由流水化 tag 路径输出的 tag 与 set 信息重构而成。如果其中一个字段比另一个字段多延迟了一拍，发出去的地址就会把一个 line 的 tag 和另一个 line 的 set index 拼在一起。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 系统从流水化 dirty-tag 元数据生成 flush 或 invalidate 请求。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 给 set-index 路径再增加一级寄存，或以其他方式让形成维护地址的 tag 与 set 字段错一拍。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 给某个地址分量增加额外流水延迟
portability_notes: 如果在另一 DUT 中更容易延迟 tag，也属于等价注入。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到拼接 flush/evict/invalidate 地址时使用的 tag 与 set index 逻辑。
只给其中一个分量增加一拍寄存。
用 dirty-line flush 流量触发并观察请求指向错误 line。
